title.target: hái méi qǐ shǒu de shíhòu

pairs.target: dìèrtiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi cóng huò háng qiánmén jìnqù , nài lěi zài mén lǐ děng , xiān jiào tā zǒu jǐbù kànkàn , méiyǒu lǐng tā zài rào hòutou de xié dào .
pairs.english: The next afternoon Tavi entered through the firm's front door; Nerai waited inside, first asking him to walk a few steps for her to see, without taking him around to the slope behind again.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天下午，塔维从货行前门进去，奈蕾在门里等，先叫他走几步看看，没有领他再绕后头的斜道。

pairs.target: píngdìshàng xīgài bù téng , tā què réng jìde shēn wān shí nà diǎn qiānchě , zǒu dào yuàn biān biàn zuòxià , jiāng zuǒjiǎo wǎngqián liú le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: On level ground his knee did not hurt, but he still remembered that slight pulling when bending deeply; he reached the courtyard's edge and sat, leaving his left foot a little forward.
pairs.hanzi: 平地上膝盖不疼，他却仍记得深弯时那点牵扯，走到院边便坐下，将左脚往前留了一点。

pairs.target: yuànzhōng nà liàng huòchē yǐ nuózǒu , qiánggēn xīntiān le liǎngzhī hòu xiē , duàn de nà zhī bú zài , tǎ wéi méi bǎ kànjiàn xīn de dàngchéng zhīdào jiù de qù le nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: That freight cart had been moved from the courtyard; two thick chocks were newly added at the wall's base, the broken one was gone; Tavi did not equate seeing new ones with knowing where the old one had gone.
pairs.hanzi: 院中那辆货车已挪走，墙根新添了两只厚楔，断的那只不在，塔维没把看见新的当成知道旧的去了哪里。

pairs.target: yìnányìnǚ zhàn zài kòngdì shàng , nǚrén zhèng jiāng wàiyī diéhǎo yā dào dèng xià , nánrén ná zhe yìgēn chán bù de cháng bàng , méi yīn tā jìnlái biàn qǐ shǒu .
pairs.english: A man and a woman stood on the open ground; the woman was folding her coat and tucking it under a stool, the man holding a cloth-wrapped long staff; they did not begin merely because he entered.
pairs.hanzi: 一男一女站在空地上，女人正将外衣叠好压到凳下，男人拿着一根缠布的长棒，没因他进来便起手。

pairs.target: nài lěi jièshào shuō , táng ruì líkāi xuégōng sìnián le , dù róng cóngqián zài chéngmén zuòshì , liǎng rén gè zǒuguò zhè duàn lù , què búshì yì kāishǐ jiù tónglù de .
pairs.english: Nerai introduced them: Tang Rui had left the academy four years ago, Du Rong had formerly worked at the city gates; both people had each travelled this stretch, but had not been travelling companions from the start.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾介绍说，唐芮离开学宫四年了，杜嵘从前在城门做事，两人各走过这段路，却不是一开始就同路的。

pairs.target: táng ruì shuō xiān biétì tā bǎ hòu bànjù bǔ chéng rújīn yě kěn yìqǐ zǒu , dù róng cháo zìjǐ jiǎo biān kàn le yìyǎn , shuō zìjǐ dài le wǔfàn , méiyǒu dài dāying dehuà .
pairs.english: Tang Rui said not to complete the second half for her yet as willing to travel together now too; Du Rong cast a glance at his own feet and said he himself had brought lunch, and had not brought words of agreement.
pairs.hanzi: 唐芮说先别替她把后半句补成如今也肯一起走，杜嵘朝自己脚边看了一眼，说自己带了午饭，没有带答应的话。

pairs.target: huò háng de rén cóng zhuōbiān guòlái , jiào tāmen xiān shìyishì , táng ruì què wèn jīnrì suàn shuí hùchē , shuí zhǐdāng kànkè , bié dǎ dào yíbàn cái fāxiàn duō le gèrén .
pairs.english: The firm's man came from the table, telling them to try first; Tang Rui, however, asked who counted as guarding the cart today and who was only watching, rather than finding another person halfway through a bout.
pairs.hanzi: 货行的人从桌边过来，叫他们先试一试，唐芮却问今日算谁护车，谁只当看客，别打到一半才发现多了个人。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhǐ gěi tā kàn tǎ wéi de wèizhì , shuō xuéshēng zhǐ kàn , tā zìjǐ yě bú xiàchǎng , zuǒshǒu réng fàngzài xī shàng , méiyǒu ná xiùkǒu zhēzhù nà liǎnggēn chímàn de zhǐtou .
pairs.english: Nerai let her see Tavi's position, saying the student would only watch; she herself would not take part either, her left hand still on her knee, without using a cuff to hide those two slow fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾指给她看塔维的位置，说学生只看，她自己也不下场，左手仍放在膝上，没有拿袖口遮住那两根迟慢的指头。

pairs.target: dù róng bǎ cháng bàng héng dào shēn qián , xiān liáng le liáng lí zhuō jiǎo háiyǒu duō yuǎn , jiào pángbiān bān dèng de rén tuì kāi , bùxǔ yǒurén cóng bèihòu chuān guòqù .
pairs.english: Du Rong held the long staff across his front, first gauging how far it still was from the table corner, and told the stool-mover nearby to step back; nobody was to cross behind him.
pairs.hanzi: 杜嵘把长棒横到身前，先量了量离桌角还有多远，叫旁边搬凳的人退开，不许有人从背后穿过去。

pairs.target: táng ruì zhè cái náchū duǎn dùn hé duǎnbàng , dùn shì mù de , lǐmiàn zhuāng zhe yípiàn biānjiè qīngchǔ de tiě , lìng yípiàn zài duǎnbàng hùshǒu shàng , dōu zhǐyǒu zhǎng biān nàme cháng , shì tā yǐjīng pèiyòng le liǎngnián de nà yíduì .
pairs.english: Only then did Tang Rui take out a short shield and stick; the shield was wooden, holding a clearly bounded iron piece inside and another in the stick's handguard; both were only about palm length; it was the pair she had already used together for two years.
pairs.hanzi: 唐芮这才拿出短盾和短棒，盾是木的，里面装着一片边界清楚的铁，另一片在短棒护手上，都只有掌边那么长，是她已经配用了两年的那一对。

pairs.target: tā jiāng liǎngjiàn dōngxī fàngdào bù shàng , qǔ le xiǎo liàngjù chá guò , xiān ràng dù róng kàn liǎngpiàn tiě de biān , zài kàn zhǎngxīn yào tiē de nà jǐchù .
pairs.english: She laid both items on the cloth and checked them with a small gauge, first letting Du Rong look at the edges of both iron pieces, then look at the places her palms would touch.
pairs.hanzi: 她将两件东西放到布上，取了小量具查过，先让杜嵘看两片铁的边，再看掌心要贴的那几处。

pairs.target: tiěmiàn shàng nà dào qiǎnqiǎn bì xiàn ràng tǎ wéi rènchū shúxī de zuòfǎ , tā méiyǒu shuō kè le xiàn biàn néng liúzhù shénme , xiān bǎ zhān dào de mùxiè fúdiào .
pairs.english: That shallow closed line on the iron let Tavi recognise a familiar method; she did not say cutting a line could retain anything, first brushing away the wood shavings stuck there.
pairs.hanzi: 铁面上那道浅浅闭线让塔维认出熟悉的做法，她没有说刻了线便能留住什么，先把沾到的木屑拂掉。

pairs.target: tā cháo qiánqīng le yìdiǎn , xī shàng qīngqīng yì chě , nài lěi jiāng dèng wǎngqián yí le shǎoxǔ , jiào tā bié ná shēnzi tì yǎnjīng pǎo .
pairs.english: He leaned forward a little, feeling a pull at his knee, light and brief; Nerai moved the stool a little forward, telling him not to make his body run in place of his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 他朝前倾了一点，膝上轻轻一扯，奈蕾将凳往前移了少许，叫他别拿身子替眼睛跑。

pairs.target: táng ruì huítóu kànjiàn tā zuò wěn , wèn xué guò nǎ yíjiàn , tǎ wéi shuō ná guò yuánlái de yíduì , zhàn zhe néng rèn yìdiǎn , cóng yòubiān lái hái děi xiān ná kōng tuō .
pairs.english: Tang Rui turned and saw him sitting steadily, asking which part he had learned; Tavi said he had held the original pair and could recognise a little while standing, but from the right still had to use empty carriers first.
pairs.hanzi: 唐芮回头看见他坐稳，问学过哪一件，塔维说拿过原来的一对，站着能认一点，从右边来还得先拿空托。

pairs.target: tā méi jiào tā ná zìjǐ de shì , fǎnér bǎ duǎn dùn fān gěi tā kàn , shuō tiě háishì zhè yìzhěngpiàn , mùtou zhǐ bāngshǒu ná zhù , búhuì yīn jiè le biàn yě biànchéng tiě .
pairs.english: She did not ask him to try her own pair; instead she turned the short shield for him to see, saying the iron was still this whole piece, the wood only helped the hand hold it and would not become iron too because of borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 她没叫他拿自己的试，反而把短盾翻给他看，说铁还是这一整片，木头只帮手拿住，不会因借了便也变成铁。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn nà jǐzhī gùdìng de xiǎo kòu , xiǎngdào mǐlā wèn guòshǒu shēn dào nǎlǐ , yòu kàn dù róng de bàng , hūrán wèn lìngyìrén shìbushì děi yìzhí děng tā .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at those fixed little clasps and remembered Mira asking where the hand would reach; then looked at Du Rong's staff, suddenly asking whether the other person had to wait for her all the time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看那几只固定的小扣，想到米拉问过手伸到哪里，又看杜嵘的棒，忽然问另一人是不是得一直等她。

pairs.target: " nǐ wèn tā . "
pairs.english: “You ask him.”
pairs.hanzi: “你问他。”

pairs.target: táng ruì shuōwán biàn qù shì hùshǒu , dù róng méi xiào , xiǎng le yíxià cái shuō , yǒushíhòu děng , yǒushíhòu bù děng , suǒyǐ děi xiān zhīdào tā zhǔnbèi hǎo le méiyǒu .
pairs.english: After speaking Tang Rui went to test the handguard; Du Rong did not smile, thought a moment, then said sometimes he waited and sometimes he did not, so he first had to know whether she was ready.
pairs.hanzi: 唐芮说完便去试护手，杜嵘没笑，想了一下才说，有时候等，有时候不等，所以得先知道她准备好了没有。

pairs.target: huò háng de rén wèn zhè shìbushì yào duō fèi hěn cháng gōngfū , táng ruì jiāng bù pūpíng , shuō ruò lián yǎnqián jǐgè rén de wèizhì dōu shuō bù míngbái , zìjǐ nìngkě xiān chīfàn .
pairs.english: The firm's man asked whether this would take much extra time; Tang Rui spread the cloth flat, saying if they could not even explain the positions of the few people right here, she herself would rather eat first.
pairs.hanzi: 货行的人问这是不是要多费很长工夫，唐芮将布铺平，说若连眼前几个人的位置都说不明白，自己宁可先吃饭。

pairs.target: dù róng tīngjiàn chīfàn , zhōngyú bǎ kàoqiáng de bùbāo nuó dào yīnchù , jiào tā bié shuōwán yòu bùchī , tā zǎoshàng zhǐ chī le yìwǎn xī de .
pairs.english: Hearing food, Du Rong finally moved the cloth bundle by the wall into the shade, telling her not to finish talking then skip eating; this morning he had eaten only a bowl of thin gruel.
pairs.hanzi: 杜嵘听见吃饭，终于把靠墙的布包挪到阴处，叫她别说完又不吃，他早上只吃了一碗稀的。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ yě shì , jiāng hòu bù diàn kòu dào yāo cè , dù róng yě jì hǎo zìjǐ de , cái wèn tǎ wéi yuànbuyuànyì kàn , shuō kànbúxiàqù suíshí jiàotíng , búbì děng dàrén xiān kāikǒu .
pairs.english: She said she was the same and fastened thick padding at her waist; Du Rong tied his own too; only then did she ask whether Tavi wanted to watch, saying he could call a stop anytime he could not bear it, without waiting for an adult to speak first.
pairs.hanzi: 她说自己也是，将厚布垫扣到腰侧，杜嵘也系好自己的，才问塔维愿不愿意看，说看不下去随时叫停，不必等大人先开口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎn le tóu , liǎng rén bǎ kòngdì kànguò , yuēdìng zhǐ zǒu bùzi , bàngtóu pèng diàn biàn tíng , bù wǎng rén méi hùzhù de dìfāng qù , yě bù línshí tiān kuài .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded; the two inspected the open space and agreed on walking only, stopping when the stick tip touched a pad, not going for unprotected places on anyone and not adding speed unexpectedly either.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点了头，两人把空地看过，约定只走步子，棒头碰垫便停，不往人没护住的地方去，也不临时添快。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi yào xiān kànjiàn yíjì piàoliang de dǎ , yǎnqián què xiān kòng chū yìtiáo zhǎilù , lùpáng méiyǒu huò , yě méiyǒu bèijiào lái zhèngmíng shuí lìhài de rén .
pairs.english: Tavi had originally expected first to see an elegant strike; instead a narrow path was first cleared before him, with no cargo alongside and no person brought in to prove who was formidable.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为要先看见一记漂亮的打，眼前却先空出一条窄路，路旁没有货，也没有被叫来证明谁厉害的人。

pairs.target: táng ruì wèn tā xiǎng buxiǎng zài kàojìn yìdiǎn , tā shuō zhèlǐ néng kànqīng , dù róng biàn bǎ cháng bàng ná zhèng , jiào tā xiān shì bú jiè de shíhòu , shěngde xuéshēng kàn wán yǐwéi mùtou yě huì tīnghuà .
pairs.english: Tang Rui asked whether he wanted to come a little closer again; he said he could see clearly here, so Du Rong straightened the long staff and told her to try without borrowing first, lest the student thought wood obeyed too after watching.
pairs.hanzi: 唐芮问他想不想再靠近一点，他说这里能看清，杜嵘便把长棒拿正，叫她先试不借的时候，省得学生看完以为木头也会听话。

pairs.target: tā jiāng liǎngshǒu tān gěi tā kàn , cái chóngxīn ná qǐ dùn hé bàng , cháng bàng mànmàn yā lái , dùn biān wǎng lǐ ràng le yìdiǎn , jiǎoxià de rén què méiyǒu zhàn chéng dīngzi .
pairs.english: She spread both hands for him to see, only then picked up the shield and stick again; the long staff pressed slowly in, the shield edge yielded inward a little, yet the person beneath it did not stand like a nail driven into the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 她将两手摊给他看，才重新拿起盾和棒，长棒慢慢压来，盾边往里让了一点，脚下的人却没有站成钉子。

alignment.english: a nail driven into the ground

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàngjiàn tā ràngkāi de nà bànbù , hūrán xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ céng bǎ qiáng dàngchéng shǎo gù yímiàn de hǎo dìfāng , zhèhuí méiyǒu jí zhe jiāng yǎnqián kòng chū de dìfāng yě quānjìn zìjǐ de cèzi .
pairs.english: Tavi saw that half-step she yielded, suddenly remembering how he himself had once treated the wall as a good place with one less side to watch; this time he did not rush to circle the newly open space before him in his own notebook too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望见她让开的那半步，忽然想起自己曾把墙当成少顾一面的好地方，这回没有急着将眼前空出的地方也圈进自己的册子。

alignment.english: with one less side to watch
